about.title: About Alpha 0.4
about.included.b: One full single-player season: pick a club, set your lineup, set each player's training, draft heroes against the clock, set your game plan, watch the match feed, read the report. 10 clubs, 18 league rounds, then a top-4 playoff (semi-finals best of 3, final best of 5). Players grow with training and tire from playing; veterans decline over the years. You also run the money: sign free agents, renew or release players, choose a sponsor, and stay out of debt. Your players also bond: starters who play together build Team chemistry (a small rating bonus), and every player has Form and Morale that follow results and playing time. Your progress saves automatically.
about.test.b: New in this build: Team chemistry (club office), Form and Morale, and the Team scrim training option. Do you understand why a player is 'in form' or 'unhappy'? Does it feel right that changing a starter costs a little chemistry? Is a game still quick (about 5 minutes with the draft)? Anything confusing, slow or broken?
about.limits.b: Transfers between clubs, youth intake, Exhibition and Quick Match, animations and art. Match results are text only. Hero and player names are placeholders.
about.report.b: Open Settings and tap Copy debug info, then paste it into your message with what you saw. Screenshots help too.

gp.title: Game plan
gp.intro: A plan moves strength between parts of the game. It helps where your team is stronger or the contest is close. Risk and aggression change how swingy the game is: they help the underdog and hurt the favourite.

gp.switch.ahead_early: Early game over: you are ahead, switching to your 'if ahead' plan.
gp.switch.vs_dive: Switching to your plan against Dive.
gp.switch.vs_siege: Switching to your plan against Siege.

chem.title: Team chemistry
chem.hint: Bonds grow when players play together. Chemistry turns the bonds of your five starters, and how clearly each one communicates, into a small bonus for the whole team.
chem.pentagon_hint: Thicker line: stronger bond (the number). Greener line: better understanding.
chem.grid_hint: Read across: how well the player on the left takes in what the player on top says, 0 to 100.
chem.bench_hint: A substitute starts from the bonds he has now. Swapping a starter costs chemistry until the new pairs have played together.
chem.scrim_hint: Set players to Team scrim in Training to build bonds a little faster. A scrim adds no stat growth.

roster.mood_help: Form follows recent results and fades with the days. Morale follows results and playing time; a starter who sits out for several matches sours. Both change the rating in matches: 1 Form is 0.4 points, about 17 Morale points is 1 point.
